messages:
incidents-bot: :warning: Alert INC-2026-0512: Quality regression detected for tenant 'zephyr-corp' on dedicated pool dp-77. Signal: semantic_accuracy_drop, metric: entailment_score -28% vs baseline after quantization rollout. Auto-escalating to P1 for tenant.
SRE-Oncall: I see the alert. dp-77 is in eu-west-2 and serves multiple dedicated tenants. Is this limited to zephyr traffic?
Maya: Checking routing logs... yes, the anomaly is concentrated on tenant_id=zephyr-corp. Recent change: qprofile v3.0.0 applied to dp-77 at 11:12 UTC.
Ola (Eng-ML): Paging Eng-ML oncall. Possible quantization-induced degradation. I'll try to reproduce using Zephyr's evaluation prompt set.
Ravi: Noted. CS (Sofia) any inbound from the tenant? They have a Dedicated + VPC contract, high priority.
Sofia (CS): Zephyr reported 'nonsensical answers' in their policy summarization workflow at ~11:20 UTC and have paused pipelines. They're asking for immediate remediation.
Eng-ML-Team: Oncall Eng-ML here. First task: instrument a per-tenant trace to capture token logits for failing requests. Ola, can you attach 10 failing examples?
Ola (Eng-ML): Pasting sanitized excerpts: 
```
prompt: "List obligations of supplier"
expected: "Supplier shall deliver X..."
actual: "Buyer must deliver..." -> swapped roles, critical error
```
Ola (Eng-ML): Repro rate ~42% on qprofile v3.0.0, ~4% on v2.9.8.
Maya: Given this is customer-impacting, mitigation candidates: (A) revert qprofile globally on dp-77 to v2.9.8, (B) per-tenant override for zephyr-corp to v2.9.8, (C) route zephyr to backup pool dp-12 with older profile, (D) pin tenant to full-precision model. Thoughts?
SRE-Oncall: Global revert could affect other tenants who benefited from perf gains; prefer per-tenant override if possible. dp-77 supports tenant-scoped profile keys.
Eng-ML-Team: Per-tenant override is safe. Note: there is a small cache miss storm when switching profiles; expect short-lived latency spikes.
Ravi: Who can execute the override and monitor? I can do the change, and Eng-ML will validate.
Sofia (CS): I'll request approval from Zephyr. They require a confirmation message before we make infra changes.
Sofia (CS): Message sent: "We detected a regression tied to a quantization update. We recommend reverting your tenant's qprofile to v2.9.8 to restore correctness (latency may increase by ~7%). Reply 'ok' to approve."
Sofia (CS): Zephyr replied 'ok please revert now' :thumbsup:.
Ravi: Applying per-tenant override now. Commands: 
```
infractl tenant-config set --tenant zephyr-corp --key quant_profile --value v2.9.8 --pool dp-77
infractl pool reload --pool dp-77 --tenant zephyr-corp --hot-reload
```
Ravi: Commands executed, awaiting hot-reload completion.
SRE-Oncall: Watch runtime logs: `kubectl -n dp-77 logs -l component=inference --tail=200 | grep zephyr-corp` and watch metrics dashboard panel 'tenant_semantic_accuracy_zephyr-corp'.
Ola (Eng-ML): Hot-reload reported success. Triggering evaluation run against tenant eval-set.
Eng-ML-Team: Early evaluation: entailment_score back to -3% vs baseline within 60s, live error-rate dropping.
Maya: Telemetry shows reduced failure rate on zephyr traffic. Noting a 9% latency increase tail p95 after override.
Sofia (CS): Notifying Zephyr: "Revert applied. Please validate. We'll monitor for 30 minutes and update."
incidents-bot: INC-2026-0512 update: mitigation applied (tenant qprofile revert), status: monitoring. Owners: Ravi (SRE), Ola (ML), Sofia (CS).
SRE-Oncall: Handoff: I'm handing incident to Ravi for monitoring and for any rollback if needed. Next oncall (SRE) in 40m: Akiko.
Ravi: Acknowledged. I'll run a 15-minute sweep for tail cases and collect token-level diffs. If anything spikes, I'll escalate to Eng-ML-Team.
Ola (Eng-ML): Preliminary root cause: a change in quantization rounding in v3.0.0 that affected softmax calibration in rare token sequences typical of contractual language. We'll fix quant kernel and add a canary test against legal-domain prompt set before next rollout.
Maya: Action items: (1) Add domain-specific canaries to qprofile rollout pipeline, (2) Implement automatic per-tenant fallback when semantic metric delta > X%, (3) Create runbook for per-tenant overrides and add to oncall handbook.
Sofia (CS): Zephyr validated: quality restored and resumed pipelines. They appreciate the quick response.
incidents-bot: INC-2026-0512 status changed to MONITORING.
Ravi: Closing note for now: impact restricted to zephyr-corp on dp-77; per-tenant revert to v2.9.8 applied at 11:28 UTC; Eng-ML to own postmortem and patch timeline.
Eng-ML-Team: We'll open a bug for the quant rounding and schedule a patch release with tests.
SRE-Oncall: Incident transferred to Ravi. Marking channel for postmortem and PM follow-up. :spiral_notepad:
